title: Abstract — liquid chrome folding into a human silhouette
useCase: Title sequence backdrop, VJ loop, brand bumper

anchor.subject: A pool of liquid chrome metal
anchor.scene: A black void with a single narrow strip light overhead
anchor.motion: Chrome rises, folds into a human silhouette, then collapses back into the pool
anchor.camera: Slow dolly around the form at eye level
anchor.light: Narrow strip light creating a horizon line of specular highlights

seedance-2.0.prompt: A pool of liquid chrome metal rests in a black void beneath a single narrow strip light. The metal rises upward in a smooth column, folds over itself, and resolves into a human silhouette with head, shoulders and arms, still reading as one continuous reflective surface. The silhouette holds for a moment, then collapses back into the pool and settles. A slow dolly camera circles the form at eye level, keeping the strip light reflected as a horizon line of specular highlights that bends with the surface. High-contrast chrome rendering, precise surface tension, deep black background, no particles, no sparks, no text, no watermark, no second figure.
seedance-2.0.notes: Abstract scenes need a start-state and an end-state; without return-to-pool the shot just ends mid-form.
